title: Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2605.18797v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scaling model performance typically requires increasing model size. Looped Transformer (LT) offers a parameter-efficient alternative by repeatedly reusing the same Transformer blocks, converting additional computation into performance gains without increasing the parameter count or context length. However, increasing the number of loop iterations makes LT increasingly difficult to optimize, often leading to gradient oscillation, residual explosion, and training collapse. We propose the Fully Looped Transformer (FLT), a simple, parameter-free redesign that addresses these problems without adding learnable parameters or imposing specially designed optimization constraints. FLT combines a Fully Looped Architecture, which exposes the recurrent state to every layer, with Attention Injection, which controls recurrent information flow through the existing attention module. These modifications enable FLT to train stably through 12 loop

translated_title: 全循环Transformer：一种简单稳定的循环稳定方法
translated_abstract: 提升模型性能通常需要增大模型规模。循环Transformer（LT）提供了一种参数高效的替代方案：通过反复复用相同的Transformer块，在不增加参数量或上下文长度的情况下，将额外的计算转化为性能提升。然而，随着循环迭代次数的增加，LT变得越来越难以优化，常常导致梯度震荡、残差爆炸和训练崩溃等问题。我们提出了全循环Transformer（FLT），这是一种简单的、不引入参数的重新设计，无需添加可学习参数或施加特殊设计的优化约束即可解决这些问题。FLT将全循环架构（Fully Looped Architecture，将循环状态暴露给每一层）与注意力注入（Attention Injection，通过现有注意力模块控制循环信息流）相结合。这些改进使FLT能够在12次循环中稳定训练。
tldr: 提出全循环Transformer（FLT），通过全循环架构和注意力注入两项无需新增参数的设计，解决了循环Transformer在多次循环迭代下难以优化的问题，实现稳定训练。
en_tdlr: Fully Looped Transformer (FLT) is a simple, parameter-free redesign combining a Fully Looped Architecture with Attention Injection to stabilize the training of Looped Transformers under many loop iterations.
